title: SYNTHETIC: mutation sensitivity requested while the accepting baseline fails must yield INVALID_BASELINE with no sensitivity figure
scientific_question: Illustrative only (the setting is fictional): do the invented depth gauges of the fictional Cobblewick canal agree with the depths an analyst declared? No real canal, gauge, person or measurement is described.
claim_tested: When `science-gate mutate` is asked for mutation sensitivity on an evidence tree whose untouched copy does not verify as PASS (here the declared depth for gauge CW-03 is 97.51 while the stored value is 97.15, so the numeric_agreement check 'depth' FAILs with SOURCE_MISMATCH), the mutation report has status FAIL, reason INVALID_BASELINE and exit code 1. It prints the verbatim sentence 'No sensitivity figure was produced because the verifier failed its accepting baseline.' It carries no sensitivity figure, omits every count key, and executes no mutation. It never converts the failing baseline into a vacuous 100% detection rate.
falsified_by: Running `science-gate mutate manifest.json` from this entry directory yields any status other than FAIL, any exit code other than 1, a reason other than INVALID_BASELINE, a mutation-report.json containing any of the keys sensitivity, applicable_mutations, executed_mutations, detected_mutations, escaped_mutations, skipped_mutations, not_applicable_mutations or mutations, or a mutation-report.md lacking the verbatim no-sensitivity sentence or the baseline's failing finding.

unresolved_cases: Only a FAIL baseline is covered. A baseline that ABSTAINs (for example an empty input) or ERRORs must also invalidate the report; no entry exercises that yet.
The baseline fails for one reason (a transposed digit in a declared expectation). Baselines failing through a hash mismatch, an omitted accepted row or a broken ledger are not covered.
